title: No engine named
summary: No engine is assumed. The files are plain PNG sheets with exact #FF00FF in every unused pixel and measured JSON atlases, so any engine or tool can use them; this guidance applies to all of them.

import_guidance.text: Make exact #FF00FF transparent when you import a sheet, and leave the delivered file unchanged.
Sample pixel art with nearest-neighbour (point) filtering, scale it only by whole numbers, and avoid compression that changes colours.
Use linear filtering for painted, illustrated, vector and rendered art, and check edges at the real display size for dark or light halos.
Use each atlas's cell rectangles, pivots, anchors and durations as written; they are measured from the delivered pixels.
Keep the gutter between frames when you pack or filter a sheet; do not trim it away.
